text:
Elena K: Hi team - my wallet was stolen while traveling and I lost my insurance card. I have a visa appointment in 3 days and they require proof of active coverage. Can we get an expedited proof/letter?
Benefits Team: Sorry that happened. Yes we can issue a temporary proof of coverage letter and also request a digital replacement card immediately. Are you currently abroad or back in the US?
Elena K: I'm in Madrid until Sunday. Appointment is at the consulate on Monday morning. Need something official I can print.
benefits-bot: Auto-reply: For expedited proof-of-coverage, submit a request to benefits@redwood.com with a photo ID and travel itinerary. Standard turnaround is 2 business days; mark as URGENT for same-day when submitted before 4pm PST.
Priya S: Elena 1 please DM a photo of your passport page (redact passport number if you prefer) and your employee ID. We'll flag as urgent and generate a letter that includes plan name, coverage dates, member ID (masked), and carrier contact details.
Elena K: DM'd passport scan and employee ID. Also, will a PDF letter from Redwood suffice at the consulate, or do they need carrier-signed docs?
Benefits Team: Most consulates accept employer/benefits-issued proof showing active plan + carrier contact. If the consulate requests carrier confirmation, we can request a carrier-stamped verification and email a cover letter to the consulate. That usually takes 24-48 hours.
Travel Admin: If you give us the consulate email, we can copy them on the carrier verification request to speed things up.
Elena K: Consulate email: madrid-consular@country.gov. Please cc them.
Priya S: Preparing documents now. The expedited proof will include:
```
- Member name: Elena K
- DOB: 1991-04-02
- Plan: Basic Care B (Employee + Family)
- Coverage: Active through 12/31/2026
- Member ID: XXXXXX321
- Carrier contact: Atlas Health, 1-800-555-0199
- Note: Issued at member request due to lost ID while traveling
```
Benefits Team: We submitted to carrier for verification and requested a carrier-signed letter. Carrier confirmed they can email a verification copy and gave tentative ETA 6-8 business hours. We also attached a Redwood-signed proof and CC'd madrid-consular@country.gov as requested. Case #BR-8745.
Elena K: Thank you 1 any chance of a same-day PDF I can print if carrier email is delayed?
Benefits Team: Yes — we attached the Redwood-issued proof as a temporary document which should be acceptable for the consulate. It has the company seal and benefits admin contact. We've also uploaded it to your employee portal secure docs. Link: https://redwood-cloud/portal/secure-docs/ElenaK/BR-8745.pdf
benefits-bot: Reminder: Please do not share full member ID publicly. The proof letter masks IDs; carrier verification contains full member ID and is sent only to the consulate or designated carrier contacts.
Elena K: Printed the PDF and brought it to a local copy shop. They printed fine and the consulate accepted it at check-in and requested carrier to confirm by email.
Benefits Team: Great news. Carrier emailed confirmation to madrid-consular@country.gov and bcc'd benefits@redwood.com. Closing note: we will also expedite a physical replacement card to your US mailing address and enable a digital card on the portal immediately. Tracking # for card shipment: TRK-559113.
Elena K: Amazing, that took a huge weight off. Thank you all!
Priya S: You're welcome. If you want, we can also add emergency contact info and a masked BIN/PCN to your secure notes for pharmacy access while abroad.
Elena K: Please add the BIN/PCN masked and emergency contact.
Benefits Team: Done. Added masked BIN (***0013) and PCN (RX****) to secure notes. Logged final case status: BR-8745
